description: The AI Assistant provides comprehensive conversational AI capabilities within the application, designed to help users navigate, find information, and perform tasks efficiently. It offers context-aware assistance, manages chat sessions, and provides entity previews to enhance user productivity and understanding across various application contexts.

pages.name: AiContentComponent
pages.description: This component provides the core AI chat functionality, allowing users to interact with the AI assistant directly within the main application layout. It offers context-aware help and entity previews, making it easier to get assistance related to your current task or data.

help_guidance.when_stuck: If you're unsure how to proceed, simply type your question into the chat input field. The AI can assist you with navigating the application, understanding specific features, locating data, or guiding you through various tasks. To review past conversations, use the chat history button located in the top bar.
common_tasks: Getting help: Ask questions about how to use application features or find specific information.
Entity assistance: Inquire about partners, contacts, or interactions to receive contextual help related to your current view.
Navigation help: Get guidance on where to locate specific features or data within the application.
Task automation: Request assistance with complex workflows or data entry processes.

pages.name: AiLayoutComponent
pages.description: This is the full-featured interface for the AI Assistant, providing robust chat session management, intelligent sidebars, and deeply context-aware assistance. It offers comprehensive AI support to help users effectively navigate and utilize the application's full potential.

help_guidance.when_stuck: To begin, type your question into the chat input field. The AI is designed to assist you with application navigation, feature understanding, data retrieval, and task execution. Utilize the sidebar to manage your chat sessions, search through previous conversations, or view entity previews. For an expanded view of the AI assistant, click the fullscreen icon.
common_tasks: Getting help: Ask questions about how to use application features or find specific information.
Managing sessions: Create new chat conversations, rename existing sessions for clarity, or search through your chat history.
Entity assistance: Inquire about partners, contacts, or interactions to receive contextual help related to your current view.
Navigation help: Get guidance on where to locate specific features or data within the application.
Task automation: Request assistance with complex workflows or data entry processes.
